scope: Available one-unit OUT from a tracked depot at h6 with TFDT0 versus TFDT2, following fixed h4 IN
manual_basis: Installed manual p478 states ItemTransfer.TFDT is ignored for OUT; native matched-pair comparison tests the statement for this installed version.
controlled_design: Accepted I02.var02 has h4 one-unit IN to DEPOT-01 and h6 one-unit OUT from DEPOT-01 with TFDT0. Change only the OUT row TFDT0→2 plus description; keep the IN row, stock, tracking, half-hour ITEM collection, seed1 and horizon36 fixed. The h6 OUT has physical stock available.
pre_run_hypotheses: The child imports and exactly roundtrips 22 populated authored tables, converts with zero errors, and yields nonempty native output.

If TFDT is ignored for OUT, the h6 physical stock removal, depot STSZ/STOHA timeline, later ordinary demand and business reports match accepted TFDT0 control. Compare full native log and all selected business report tables, not just summary means.
A delayed departure/arrival, changed physical identity, changed stock timeline or divergent downstream state is an observed counterexample and must be classified explicitly.
acceptance_gate: Publish ignored OUT delay only when exact source delta, guarded native run, direct physical h6 OUT, 72-bin depot ItemResults, full business report comparison, source-bound sealed evidence and independent replay agree. Otherwise publish only a bounded observed counterexample if supported.
limits: one available one-unit OUT after h4 IN, one IID/depot, TFDT0 versus 2, one seed
no standalone OUT, shortage, split/backorder, other delays, GUI rendering or cross-engine parity
